with_moving_lock_parts.scope: C2 ladder + two C3 discs/hubs. Missing drive and couplings may add moving mass.

drive.scope: Unoccupied motion only. 24:1 S24 + proposed 2:1 external stage. Efficiencies are assumptions, not measured performance. No reverse-efficiency, holding, braking or exit-time acceptance is inferred.

locks.scope: Static force demand only. No allowable stress, pin bending, edge tear-out, carrier, hub attachment, fatigue, transport acceleration, impact, wind or positive-retention approval.

mass.scope: Gross study inventory, not a net LT32 addition. Old pins/cheeks/latches need removal and new carriers/drive/guards/cables need inclusion. Current C2 504-case results are unchanged and do not qualify C3.

assumptions: Rigid-body quasistatic gravity, trial CAD densities, symmetric ladder sides.
Index holes are nominal diameters and coordinates, not fits or manufacturing tolerances.
10-angle exact solid check covers isolated cartridges only, not the C2 cab, hand clearance, ground or continuous swept volume.
No person is carried while the ladder moves. A supported, instrumented rig must precede occupied trials.
